saw_lines: Luxury underwear gets bought in sets, replaced as it wears out, and gifted, so buyers judge fabric and fit before they click.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where fabric and fit must be proven before the click.
Your site shows 150 years of craftsmanship, yet 0 of 30 ads carry it, so put 150 years on every creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site leads with 150 years of craftsmanship, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so buyers get no proof before the click. Put 150 years on every creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your homepage offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the discount in the opening line of three new ads and print it on the creative.

13 of 30 ads open on the same modern luxury story, so they overlap in one audience. Test three new openers built on the Signature Silk Touch feel, sleep to lounge wear and the Swiss finishing, each against the current story.

Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers must click away to learn how orders arrive. Answer shipping in the first line of new ads and state the free shipping offer there.

ads_1: Signature Silk Touch and sleep to lounge openers, tested against the current story
